TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms its intent to comply with the Provincial Health Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s requirements for supply, implementation, integration, and support of an integrated HMIS across four tertiary-care hospitals, and we have delivered comparable hospital IT deployments for government clients within the last five years, including a Provincial Government hospital IT deployment completed in 2023 [CAP-018] and a Federal Government hospital IT deployment completed in 2020 [CAP-042].

We are compliant with the mandatory bidder eligibility items evidenced in our company fact sheet, including SECP incorporation and FBR NTN with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status [CO-PROFILE], and holding ISO 27001 certification [CO-PROFILE]. We also field PMP-certified project managers (six PMP-certified PMs) to lead delivery and governance [CO-PROFILE]. We can provide the required bid security in the form of a CDR/bank guarantee from a scheduled bank within our established bank guarantee facility [CO-PROFILE].

For the solution scope (EMR; OPD/IPD; LIS/RIS; pharmacy/inventory; billing/insurance; central data warehouse/dashboards; HL7/FHIR interoperability; legacy data migration; training for ~1,200 users; and three years O&M), our library evidences end-to-end hospital IT delivery experience [CAP-018][CAP-042] and enterprise/infra programs delivered under ISO 27001 controls [CAP-012][CAP-050]. However, our library does not yet evidence specific HL7 v2.x/FHIR R4 implementations, a quantified 99.5% monthly availability with RTO=4 hours, or a documented migration validation/reconciliation methodology; we will address these PARTIAL areas by submitting a standards-aligned interoperability design and a DR/availability architecture in Q3, and a documented migration, reconciliation, and training plan (including ~1,200 staff) in Q4, with 24/7 helpdesk SLAs detailed in Q5 per our established support model [CO-PROFILE].

Mandatory GAP: we do not hold a valid CMMI Level 5 appraisal; we currently hold CMMI Level 3 [CO-PROFILE]. To close this, we will propose delivery under our CMMI L3 processes and, if required by the Department as a condition of award, engage a CMMI Level 5–appraised software development partner for regulated SDLC activities; our library does not yet evidence such a partner and we will disclose the selected firm and appraisal evidence at contract finalization [CO-PROFILE].
